$description: Corner radii, shadows and the scrim.

radius-sm.$description:
── Shape & elevation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
In LIGHT these are shadows; in DARK the surface lightens instead, and
the shadow only has to separate it from a near-black ground.

light-dark() switches colours, not geometry, and the two themes' blur
differs. So shadows 2 and 3 carry one layer per theme, with the other
theme's layer transparent — it draws nothing.
